_comment: Theme 2 S2 invalid-row-rejection roster. VERBATIM RECORD ONLY — every table row the gate rounds ever wrote for each control id, in round order, with each source doc's sha256. `expected` is null on every entry by design: no expectation is inferred here. Literalizing all 100 expectations, and supplying executable SQL for each, is the S2 protocol's first obligation (protocol section 2). The roster does not bind until that amendment lands.
